escalation_condition: Bluish lips or face (cyanosis), inability to speak full sentences, gasping, or audible wheezing
source: AHA / ERC Guidelines for Acute Respiratory Distress
approved_actions: Help the person sit upright leaning slightly forward with arms resting on their knees (tripod position).
Loosen tight collars, ties, and belts to free their chest.
Ensure the room has fresh air; open windows and ask crowds to step back.
If the person has their own prescribed asthma inhaler or spacer, assist them in taking it.
Encourage slow, calm breaths in through the nose and out through pursed lips.
critical_actions: Keep the patient upright; do not force them to lie down.
contraindications: Never force an asthmatic or dyspneic patient to lie flat.
Do not offer water or food while gasping.
